seoTitle: Dr Vaidik Chauhan - Silver Touch Hospital
html:
Qualification
MBBS – Smt.NHL Municipal Medical College
M.S ENT – B.J Medical College Ahmedabad
Certified in Endoscopic Sinus Surgery – CeMAST Mumbai
Cochlear Implant Training – Civil Hospital
Ahmedabad under Dr.Rajesh Vishwakarma

Dr.Vaidik was born in Ahmedabad Gujarat. He attended Medical School in Prestigious Smt.NHL Medical college Ahmedabad. He Completed his Master of surgery in ENT from world renowned B.J Medical colleg, Civil Hospital,Ahmedabad. Dr.Vaidik love spending times in making teaching videos for under and post graduate students. He also learns Advance ENT surgery from various Surgeons all over the Globe.

SPECIAL SURGICAL INTEREST:

  • Endoscopic Ear Surgery
    For Cholesteatoma, Ear Drum Perforation and Foreign body removal
  • Endoscopic Nasal Surgery For Nasal Polyp, foreign body removal Sinus Diseases
  • Pediatric Surgery
    For Tonsillitis and adenoid embryological anomalies
  • Neck Surgery & Endocrine Surgery For Thyroid, Parathyroid, Parotid, Submandibular gland diseases
  • Laryngeal Surgery For vocal cord polyp, cancer and other voice disorders

RESEARCH, ACADEMIC, COMMUNITY WORKS:

  • Dr. Vaidik has done more than 2500 ear nose and throat related surgeries. He also has 12 publications in various state, national and International Journals. He has done oral presentations at various national conferences and won award.
  • Dr. Vaidik has attended many national and international conferences and participated actively in live surgical demonstration.
  • He also runs a youtube channel for the purpose of education medical students and post graduate students to learn surgeries in a better way.
  • He organizes free medical health checkup camps for the community and poor patients.
